summary: ExchangeRight Income Fund, a Maryland statutory trust and REIT, filed an 8-K on October 5, 2026 reporting an amendment to its Operating Partnership's limited partnership agreement creating two new series of NLP Common Units, NLP 51 and NLP 53. The new series facilitate future acquisitions of net-leased Delaware statutory trust portfolios through unit issuance as consideration. The general partner approved the amendment without limited partner approval, and it became effective immediately. No financial terms, prices, stakes, premiums, or closing dates were disclosed. This is an internal structural/authorization event, not a special situation; no deal or transaction is announced.
